name: x-context
description: Read your own X posts and their metrics through the official X API, cached locally, so agents draft new posts from what actually worked for you — and never repeat what you already said. Read-only.

x_api_key.title: X API Key (consumer key)
x_api_key.description: console.x.com → your app → Keys and tokens. With the 3 other OAuth 1.0a keys, reading your own posts is billed as an owned read ($0.001/post) and adds owner-only metrics.

x_api_secret.title: X API Key Secret
x_api_secret.description: Consumer secret of the same app.

x_access_token.title: X Access Token
x_access_token.description: Access token generated for YOUR account (the app owner), Read permission is enough.

x_access_token_secret.title: X Access Token Secret
x_access_token_secret.description: Secret of the access token above.

x_bearer_token.title: X Bearer Token (fallback)
x_bearer_token.description: Only if you don't use the four OAuth 1.0a keys. App-only reads cost $0.005/post and have no owner metrics. Requires the username below.

x_username.title: X username
x_username.description: Your @handle, without the @. Required with a bearer token, optional with OAuth keys.

data_dir.title: Cache directory (optional)
data_dir.description: Where fetched posts are cached. Empty = the plugin data dir, which is deleted on uninstall unless you pass --keep-data. Set a path to keep posts you already paid for.
